bibl.title: P. Gen. inv. 376 – Ein neues Fragment von Isokrates’ Panegyrikos
bibl.seg: Tobias Hirsch & Lorenzo Sardone, P. Gen. inv. 376 - Ein neues Fragment von Isokrates' Panegyrikos.
bibl.note: Edition of the yet unidentified P. Gen. Inv. 376 containing Isoc. 4.108-109. Remarkable is a variant in the margin (l. 26), which indicates a process of collation between different ancient textual traditions.
